scope: Bedroom submenu fidelity, literal message escapes, text bounds and requested trackpad mouse mode

choice_fix.cause: The parallel mouse adapter queues Confirm after the tap that opens a choice. The previous runtime accepted it as a separate selection.
choice_fix.behavior: New choices wait for the opening mouse/basic press and its deferred input to be released; all original strings, conditions and branch indices remain in the unchanged IR.
choice_fix.mouse_query: 0 idle, 2 new press, 1 held, matching the official manual.
choice_fix.windows_fixture: An automatic Confirm queued immediately before a choice leaves the original choice open at frame 10.

message_fix.behavior: Unrecognized backslash sequences display literally, matching the supplied Windows executable. Known unsupported controls still stop.
message_fix.native_fixture: Original file is read by opcode 122 and rendered through opcode 101 without a compatibility error.

text_bounds.cause: A smaller initial font size retained the default height, and trailing newlines enlarged centered text pictures.
text_bounds.limits: Font pixel appearance still differs from Windows; this check validates bounds and centering, not pixel identity.

mouse_mode.enable: Show controls with three-dot toggle, then Menu -> Enable mouse mode
mouse_mode.move: Drag like a trackpad; moving does not click
mouse_mode.click: Tap after moving; brief two-tick click supports original held-state menus
mouse_mode.cancel: Hold without moving for at least 450 ms and release, or use Cancel
mouse_mode.verification: Native startup/cursor render and SDL fixture gestures pass; iPhone touch verification remains outstanding

limits: Development-state continuations, not a new full end-to-end playthrough
New touch behavior requires iPhone verification
